culling: Alpha-aware native first-hit union across original9 plus24 side/rear cameras. All newly side-visible native faces protected at every own-region prefix. Physical poses/supports unchanged.
selector: Native primary and all side/rear surfaces are mandatory. Exempt copies always use full native meshes. Remove unprotected old extra-angle faces only; report an over-budget result when protected faces exceed60,000. No automatic protected-surface decimation.
alpha_visibility: GhostSkull blend: retain positive-alpha layers through to opaque depth. Tooth clip: continue rays through alpha<=cutoff. Nearest texture sampling matches the source helper. Transparent meshes never act as solid depth cards.
alpha_primary_visibility: GhostSkull blend: retain positive-alpha layers through to opaque depth. Tooth clip: continue rays through alpha<=cutoff. Nearest texture sampling matches the source helper. Transparent meshes never act as solid depth cards.
